primary_hypothesis: H55-1: local signed second-derivative zero-crossing pairs in gravity and RTP magnetics, conditioned on modelled cover and weak surface expression

candidate_features.normalized_signed_laplacian_of_gaussian: -sigma^2 times scipy gaussian_laplace of normalized-convolution Gaussian-smoothed band, sigma in pixels
candidate_features.sign_change: 8-neighbour 3x3 local minimum < 0 < local maximum of LoG response
candidate_features.edge_response: sign_change multiplied by gradient magnitude per metre; signed LoG retained as a separate feature

spatial_layout: four contiguous quadrants; whole original 8-connected catalogue components assigned by majority quadrant; evaluation region includes held component tails
negative_class: catalogue-zero proxy, not verified fault absence
budget_rule: same positive-pixel density on each outer evaluation region as global budget divided by eligible footprint
placement: triangular 300 m max-cover greedy at matched budget; no held-out truth labels enter placement

promotion_gate.failure_action: do not spend a weekly competition slot; research artifact only
